{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Health care should be a right in America, not a privilege.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Every American deserves the peace of mind that quality, affordable coverage brings.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats fought to pass the Affordable Care Act, providing 45 million Americans with insurance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act guarantees protections for 100 million people with preexisting conditions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act protects nearly 180 million people from lifetime coverage limits.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump and Republicans are threatening to repeal the Affordable Care Act.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will not let the Affordable Care Act be repealed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to protect and expand the Affordable Care Act, making quality care more accessible and affordable.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Biden-Harris Administration has made quality care more accessible and affordable.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More Americans have health insurance than ever in history.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Coverage is up and costs are down.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A record 21 million people signed up through the Affordable Care Act this year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The uninsured rate has been reduced from 16 percent in 2010 to under 8 percent now.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats have expanded the health insurance premium tax credit twice, saving millions of Americans an average of $800 a year on coverage.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Expanded health insurance premium tax credits have helped an additional 1.7 million Latinos buy more affordable insurance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Expanded health insurance premium tax credits have helped an additional 830,000 Black Americans buy more affordable insurance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Expanded health insurance premium tax credits have helped an additional 110,000 Asian Americans buy more affordable insurance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans want to let health insurance premium tax credits expire, increasing premiums.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to make health insurance premium tax credits permanent.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
